prediction.raw: I would say 1 (You Are The Asshole) in this scenario. Here's why: While it's understandable that you might not be interested in the first aid class, it was a mandatory requirement for your school, and you were expected to participate. By texting and playing games on your phone, you were being disrespectful to the instructor and not giving the class the attention it deserved. When the instructor called you out and asked you to put your phone away, you should have complied. Instead, you ignored her and continued to disrupt the class. Your behavior was not only rude but also uncooperative. When you snapped at the instructor and said that the material didn't apply to you, you came across as entitled and dismissive. It's true that you didn't sign up for the class, but that doesn't mean you can't learn something new or appreciate the value of the information being presented. By walking out of the class, you not only disrupted the learning environment but also showed a lack of respect for the instructor, your peers, and the school's rules. Your parents and friend are right to be upset with you, as your behavior was unacceptable. It's not about whether or not you think you'll use the information in the future; it's about being a responsible and respectful member of your school community. You should have found a way to engage with the material, even if it didn't interest you, and respected the instructor's authority.
